cues.text: After cleaning, every order has to be put back together. This is called assembly. The tag number is your guide.
Read the tag number on the garment.
Find the ticket with the same number. You can type the tag number in Ticket List.
Count the pieces. The ticket says how many, for example: pants times two, blouse times one.
Check the colors. The ticket lists the color of each piece. Navy pants should not end up in a black pants order.
Keep sets together. A suit jacket and its pants always hang together.
Only when every piece is there, mark it ready and put it on its rack.
If a piece is missing, do not bag it and do not mark it ready.
Look in the cleaning area and at the pressing stations. Missing pieces are usually still there.
Still missing? Tell a manager the same day.
